in_hebrew.name: הריאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Harrell is derived from the Hebrew word 'harel', meaning 'mountain of God'. This name is a reminder of the faith and devotion to God that should be evident in the lives of those who bear this name.

in_greek.name: Ἁρέλλος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Harrell in Greek is translated as 'Harrellos', meaning 'Mountain of God'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'harel', and reflects the idea of God's presence and protection.

in_latin.name: Harrellus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Harrell in Latin is 'Harrellus', which also means 'Mountain of God'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'harel', and carries the same meaning as in the Hebrew and Greek languages.
